meta.name: hunt-threat
meta.description: Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunting. Use when performing advanced hunting based on threat intelligence, TTPs, or anomalies. For Tier 3 analysts or dedicated threat hunters. Supports iterative search, pivoting, and comprehensive documentation.

copy.tagline: 主动搜寻网络中的威胁迹象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是安全分析师，需要主动发现隐藏的威胁。
copy.tagline_en: Proactively hunt for threats in your network
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a security analyst needing to uncover hidden threats.

howto.what: Claude会按照威胁狩猎流程，从定义假设开始，结合威胁情报进行迭代搜索分析，自动记录发现并生成狩猎报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行高级威胁狩猎，或需要基于威胁情报、TTPs或异常进行主动搜索时触发。

say.text: 帮我针对DNS隧道技术进行威胁狩猎，范围是最近7天。
say.note: Claude会启动狩猎流程，定义假设并执行查询。

say.text: 调查PowerShell异常执行，目标服务器是关键系统。
say.note: Claude会迭代搜索并分析结果。

say.text: 基于GTI报告CVE-2025-xxxx，进行相关TTP的狩猎。
say.note: Claude会深度分析情报并开发查询。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow a threat hunting workflow: define a hypothesis, leverage threat intelligence, perform iterative search and analysis, document findings, and generate a hunt report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user requests advanced threat hunting or proactive search based on threat intelligence, TTPs, or anomalies.

say_en.text: Hunt for DNS tunneling techniques over the past 7 days.
say_en.note: Claude starts the hunting workflow, defines hypothesis, and runs queries.

say_en.text: Investigate anomalous PowerShell execution on critical servers.
Hunt based on GTI report CVE-2025-xxxx for related TTPs.
say_en.note: Claude deeply analyzes intel and develops queries.
